statement: The exact Bluetooth SDP record, HID descriptor bytes, radio pairing/reconnect/security behavior and physical timing for a retail Switch Pro are not established by the pinned Linux/SDL consumer implementations or community notes. A locally authored UHID descriptor is a model, not a measured physical descriptor.
